articles.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs

articles.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
articles.summary: AI is expensive, Ali Ghodsi tells TechCrunch. With so many investors wanting into his latest round, he said yes to more than planned.

articles.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
articles.summary: OpenAI has replaced chief revenue officer Denise Dresser after just nine months on the job, tapping Wiz president and chief operating officer Dali Rajic to take on frontier lab's top sales job.

articles.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps

articles.title: Record-setting geothermal bid signals rising interest in federal leases
articles.summary: One parcel in New Mexico sold for $701 per acre in June. Analysts cited stronger bidder competition as the Bureau of Land Management prepares for another lease sale in Utah scheduled for August 18.

articles.title: Software-based initiative could unlock up to 20% more bulk capacity: OATI
articles.summary: OATI seeks federal funding for widespread deployment of dynamic line rating software, near-real-time inter-regional coordination and AI-enhanced resource dispatch — none of which requires new poles or wires, the company says.

articles.title: Mitsubishi’s large-frame gas turbine backlog reaches 35 GW
articles.summary: The company plans to double its manufacturing capacity as it continues to see a “strong supply-demand environment” for gas turbines in the U.S., CFO Hiroshi Nishio said.

articles.title: Texas hits new peak demand record, but supply constraints will limit growth
articles.summary: Ascend Analytics says more than 80% of new large loads seeking interconnection will not have matching generation online by 2030, even as data centers and industrial demand continue to surge.

articles.title: ConEd plans 28 new substations by 2035
articles.summary: The New York-based utility company is pursuing growth through electrification, in alignment with city and state climate policies, it said last week.

articles.title: Dominion ordered to directly assign some transmission costs to data centers
articles.summary: The Virginia State Corporation Commission said it may use an upcoming docket to weigh whether this policy “could or should” also apply to more upstream transmission costs.

articles.title: Xcel asks Colorado Supreme Court to facilitate wind farm interconnection
articles.summary: In June, a district court judge rejected PSCo’s effort to acquire roughly 550 feet of easement via eminent domain to connect two nearly complete wind farms totaling more than 1 GW. The utility says the project delays are harming ratepayers.

articles.title: PJM eyes data center, crypto reliability requirements after 3.8 GW of load trips offline
articles.summary: The PJM Interconnection is considering setting “ride-through” standards after data centers tripped offline in Northern Virginia on July 22, the latest and largest such event in PJM’s history, the grid operator said.

articles.title: The US infrastructure buildout needs more than capital
articles.summary: The country is not short on infrastructure ambition; what it risks running short on is orchestration, writes Daryl Walcroft, PwC's capital projects and infrastructure leader.

articles.title: Pay-as-you-go batteries: ‘One weird trick’ for the distribution grid?
articles.summary: Battery leases with low or no up-front costs are attractive in markets with well-developed virtual power plant programs and persistent grid congestion, but experts see them taking off elsewhere, too.

articles.title: Romanian plant taken offline as Hungary moves to keep Paks operating
articles.summary: Romania has taken the second unit of the Cernavoda nuclear power plant offline because of the record-low water level in the River Danube. Meanwhile, the Hungarian government has announced measures to enable the Paks plant to continue operating.

articles.title: IAEA, Canadian university collaborate on nuclear education
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency and Canada's University of Saskatchewan have signed an agreement to strengthen cooperation in knowledge management and education, supporting nuclear energy research and workforce development.

articles.title: Site preparations under way for planned Kola units
articles.summary: The start of site preparation works for the Kola II nuclear power units follows the granting of a site licence by Russian regulator Rostekhnadzor earlier this month.

articles.title: ARC partners with INL for SMR deployment
articles.summary: ARC Clean Technology has signed an agreement aiming for the first-of-a-kind deployment of an ARC-100 small modular reactor at Idaho National Laboratory.

articles.title: Dominion keeps options open for North Anna new build
articles.summary: Dominion Energy is taking steps to preserve the Early Site Permit issued to its North Anna site in 2007. The Louisa County site is already home to two operating reactors.

articles.title: New Chinese reactors reach start-up milestones
articles.summary: Unit 3 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province has begun supplying electricity to the grid, while unit 2 of the Taipingling plant in Guangdong has entered commercial operation. Both units feature Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors.

articles.title: China approves construction of eight more reactors
articles.summary: The construction of three pairs of Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors at the Jinqimen, Taipingling and Zhuanghe sites, as well as two Guohe One (CAP1400) reactors at the Laiyang site was approved during a State Council executive meeting chaired by Chinese Premier Li Qiang on 31 July.

articles.title: Core catcher installed at Leningrad's eighth unit
articles.summary: The 157-tonne steel core catcher has been installed in place at what will be the eighth unit at the Leningrad nuclear power plant in Russia.

articles.title: KHNP, AboitizPower to cooperate on nuclear energy
articles.summary: AboitizPower Corporation, a leading Philippine energy company, has signed a memorandum of understanding with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power to explore cooperation on nuclear energy technologies and their potential deployment in the Philippines.

articles.title: Entergy to consider deployment of Holtec's SMR-300
articles.summary: Holtec International has signed a memorandum of agreement with US utility Entergy and South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction to evaluate opportunities to advance the potential deployment of its SMR-300 small modular reactor for large-load customers across Entergy's service territory.

articles.title: Tianwan 8 completes key commissioning tests
articles.summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 8 of the Tianwan nuclear power plant in China's Jiangsu province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Bechtel assumes responsibility for Polish plant site
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe, which plans to build Poland's first nuclear power plant, announced it has handed over management of the project site to general contractor Bechtel as earthworks start on the construction site.

articles.title: US test reactors achieve milestones
articles.summary: Nuclear technology company Oklo has announced its Groves Isotope Test Reactor has achieved first criticality, while Deep Fission's underground reactor has received safety design approval. Both reactors are part of the USA's Reactor Pilot Program.

articles.title: Rosatom staff begin returning to Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant
articles.summary: The first five Russian engineering specialists have returned to the Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant in Iran, Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said.

articles.title: Changjiang 4 control room commissioned
articles.summary: The main control room of unit 4 at the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province has been commissioned ahead of the reactor's start up in early 2027.

articles.title: First criticality for Mochovce 4
articles.summary: Slovakia's newest nuclear power unit, Mochovce 4 has reached critical status and minimum controlled power.

articles.title: Containment of first Egyptian unit takes shape
articles.summary: Concreting work on the fourth tier of the reactor building's inner containment at unit 1 of Egypt's El Dabaa nuclear power plant has been completed, the Nuclear Power Plants Authority announced.

articles.title: First fuel loaded into Tianwan unit 7
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 7 of the Tianwan nuclear power plant has begun. It is the first of two Russian-designed VVER-1200 reactors under construction at the site in China's Jiangsu province.

articles.title: Construction of Bailong 2 conventional island begins
articles.summary: The first concrete pour has been completed for the basemat of the conventional island of unit 2 at the Bailong nuclear power plant in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of southern China, State Power Investment Corporation announced.

articles.title: CNNC to procure contract for high-temperature reactor
articles.summary: China National Nuclear Corporation plans to soon procure a high-temperature reactor engineering contracting project for the first phase of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China's Jiangsu province.
